summary: Converts technical book PDFs into interactive LLM-powered skills for study and reference, leveraging RAG and context engineering.
usecases: Create personalized study guides from technical textbooks or documentation.
Enable developers to query and reference book content as an interactive AI skill while coding.
Build a knowledge base from technical literature for team onboarding and reference.
ideas: Integrate with code editors for inline code examples and explanations from the book.
Support multi-language book processing with automatic translation and summarization.
Combine with vector databases for semantic search across multiple technical books.
